blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano has made clear that Sen. Mark Villar remains in the minority, after the latter did not vote along with the minority bloc in the impeachment court last Wednesday. Villar joined the majority bloc in voting against presiding officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero’s previous ruling that the vote required to convict Vice President Sara Duterte is 16. At that time, Cayetano and minority composed of Sens. Camille Villar, Pia Cayetano, Imee Marcos, Christopher “Bong” Go and Robin Padilla boycotted the division of the floor.
